questions.q_en: What was the day of the week on 6th August 1601?
questions.solution_en:
6th August 1601 means 1600 years and days from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601.

Odd no. of days in first 1600 years is 0 (Odd days in 1600 years - 0 and odd days in 400 years - 0).

No. of Days from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601 = 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 6 = 218 (which is 31 weeks and 1 day).

Hence, there is 1 odd day from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601.

Total odd days = 0 + 1 = 1, which is 1 odd day.

Hence, it was a Monday on 6th August 1601.
